description:
Hermès Mini Kelly 20 II Sellier 20cm
Matte Alligator Mississippiensis • Gold Hardware • Nata Interior • G Stamp 2026
Brand New in Box | Full Set | Never Worn

An exceptionally rare opportunity to acquire a truly unique Hermès Mini Kelly 20 Sellier in luxurious Matte Alligator Mississippiensis, finished in a rich Gold exterior with striking contrast white saddle stitching and elegant Gold Hardware.

This highly sought-after piece bears the coveted G Stamp (2026 production) and remains in pristine, unworn condition with all protective stickers still intact on the hardware.

What makes this bag particularly special is its stunning Nata interior, a beautiful creamy white shade that creates an unexpected and sophisticated contrast against the warm Gold matte alligator exterior. The combination is both timeless and exceptionally rare.

Unlike the vast majority of Gold Matte Alligator Mini Kelly bags, which are produced with matching tonal stitching, this example was specially commissioned with contrast white stitching, creating a dramatic Sellier silhouette and showcasing Hermès craftsmanship at its finest.

To the best of our knowledge, there is currently no other example available on the market with this exact specification. This was an exclusive special order style produced for a VIP client, making it a highly collectible piece for the discerning Hermès collector.

name: Birkin 25 leather handbag
description:
An Hermès Special Order (HSS) Birkin 25 in Togo leather combining Noir (Black) and Anémone (rich purple) is one of the most highly coveted custom handbags in the ultra-luxury market. The "Horseshoe" stamp next to the Hermès logo signifies it as a unique, custom-designed piece reserved exclusively for the brand's top VIP clients.

The color purple primarily symbolizes royalty, luxury, spirituality, and creativity. Because it combines the fierce energy of red with the calm stability of blue, purple strikes a unique psychological balance that evokes both a sense of high status and deep introspection.

Key Specifications
* Model: Hermès Birkin 25 Togo Horseshoe Black Anemone
* Material: Togo leather, known for its fine grain, scratch resistance, and excellent shape retention.
* Colorway: A custom bi-color combination of Noir (Black) and Anémone (Deep Violet/Purple). Typically, one color is featured on the exterior with the contrasting color highlighting the interior, stitching, or piping.
* Hardware: Palladium Hardware (PHW)
* Exclusivity: Marked with an engraved Horseshoe Stamp (HSS)

Why This Combination is Highly Prized
* Versatile Pop: Noir provides a classic, everyday look, while Anémone offers a vivid, sophisticated splash of color.
* Size Demand: The 25cm "Baby Birkin" is currently the most popular and investment-stable size due to the high demand for compact bags.
* Market Rarity: Because HSS slots are limited to select VIPs once or twice a year, finding this exact combination on the secondary market via luxury authenticators is rare and carries a high premium.

Original plastic still on center plaque. The bag was sent to the Hermes bag a few years ago to have the ostrich conditioned to keep and maintain its beautiful color and feel.

Comes with 2x Orange Dustbags, Original Tags (Purchased at Hermes boutique in Japan), Raincoat, Lock, 2x Keys and Clochette.

name: Birkin 25 leather handbag
description:
Hermès Birkin 25 — Blue Electric / Togo Leather / Gold Hardware / Stamp U

Bold, luminous, and utterly unforgettable — this Hermès Birkin 25 in Blue Electric is one of the most coveted color-hardware combinations in the collector market. The electric cobalt blue pops against the warm gold hardware in a pairing that is both striking and timeless. The 25cm is the most petite and exclusive of the classic Birkin sizes, making it the rarest and most difficult to acquire directly from Hermès — a true grail piece.
Details at a Glance:

Size: 25cm
Color: Blue Electric (vibrant cobalt/royal blue)
Leather: Togo (pebbled calfskin)
Hardware: Gold-tone (GHW)
Date Stamp: U
Origin: Made in France
Condition: Excellent — presents beautifully with virtually no signs of meaningful wear

Why the Birkin 25:

The 25cm is the smallest and most exclusive Birkin silhouette — compact, structured, and effortlessly chic. Harder to source than the 30 or 35, it commands a premium in both the primary and secondary markets and holds its value exceptionally well.

Why Togo:

Naturally pebbled, scratch-resistant, and supple — Togo holds its structured silhouette beautifully while softening gracefully with use. One of the most durable and sought-after Hermès leathers.
What's Included — COMPLETE FULL SET:

✦ Hermès orange box
✦ Hermès dust bag
✦ Padlock with clochette
✦ Keys (2)
✦ Rain cover
✦ Care booklet

A complete full set Birkin 25 is extraordinarily rare in the secondary market. Everything is present and accounted for — ready to be gifted, stored, or carried straight out of the box.

description:
Hermès Birkin 30 | Gris Tourterelle | Novillo Leather | Palladium Hardware | Stamp Z (2021) | Full Set
Presenting an exceptionally rare opportunity — a 2021 Hermès Birkin 30 in pristine condition, in the eternally coveted Gris Tourterelle color, crafted from Novillo leather with Silver Palladium hardware. This is a post-2020 production piece, among the most sought-after on the current resale market, reflecting Hermès' current craftsmanship standards at their peak.
The Specifications:

Style: Birkin 30
Color: Gris Tourterelle — warm turtledove grey, one of Hermès' most timeless and versatile neutrals
Leather: Novillo — semi-matte grained calfskin, celebrated for its exceptional durability, scratch resistance, and refined texture that develops a beautiful patina over time
Hardware: Silver Palladium Hardware (PHW) — bright, contemporary finish in perfect condition
Date Stamp: Z (2021) — post-2020 production, premium category
Included: Original Hermès box, herringbone twill dust bag, lock, clochette, and keys

Why Gris Tourterelle in Novillo:
Gris Tourterelle is among the easiest-to-wear neutrals in the entire Hermès color universe — a warm, sophisticated turtledove grey that transitions effortlessly from casual to formal, day to night, through every season. Unlike trend-dependent colors, the demand for Gris Tourterelle has never waned, and it is increasingly difficult to source directly from Hermès boutiques. Novillo leather amplifies the investment appeal of this bag — it is one of the most resilient calfskins produced by Hermès, highly resistant to daily wear while maintaining a supple, luxurious feel.
Hardware and Authentication Details:

HERMES — PARIS engraved on the turn-lock plate
Blind stamp Z confirmed on the interior leather strap
Lock correctly stamped and matching
Clochette and two keys present
All hardware in mirror-bright palladium condition — no tarnish, scratching, or oxidation

The Investment Case:
Pristine Birkins can fetch up to 3x the retail price, and the original box, dust bag, lock, keys, clochette, and receipt further increase value by 5-15%. Pristine Togo Birkin 30 bags continue to trade around $28,000 to $30,000 in the market. Novillo commands comparable premiums to Togo given its similar durability profile and collector appeal. Hermès retakes the top spot for bag resale value retention with a remarkable 138% value retention rate, highlighting how resilient and sought-after these bags have become.

This is not just a handbag — it is a wearable asset that has consistently appreciated year-over-year and shows no signs of slowing down.

name: Birkin 30 leather handbag
description:
Hermès Birkin 30 — Gold / Chevre Leather / Gold Hardware / Stamp C

A true collector's piece, this Hermès Birkin in the iconic Gold colorway is crafted in Chevre leather — the highly sought-after goatskin that Hermès no longer produces at scale, making stamp C examples increasingly rare and desirable among serious collectors. Chevre is prized for its naturally tight, fine grain, exceptional durability, and the way it holds its structure beautifully over time, developing a rich, luminous patina with age.

Details at a Glance:
- Size: 30cm
- Color: Gold (warm camel/tan)
- Leather: Chevre (goatskin)
- Hardware: Gold-tone (GHW)
- Date Stamp: C (indicating production year)
- Condition: Very Good — this bag presents beautifully with minimal signs of wear consistent with careful, light use

What's Included:
- Hermès padlock with clochette
- Keys

Styled in photos with an Hermès Twilly scarf and a Rodeo PM charm (available separately upon request)

This is a rare opportunity to own a Birkin in discontinued Chevre leather — a combination that commands a premium at auction and in the collector market. Gold on Gold is one of the most versatile, timeless Birkin configurations ever produced.

name: Haut à Courroies leather weekend bag
description:
Hermès HAC Haut à Courroies 50 Black and Blue Verso Togo 2008

• Brand: Hermès
• Model: Haut à Courroies 50
• Year: 2008
• Color: Black / Dark Blue
• Material: Togo
• Hardware: PHW (Polished Palladium)
• Stamp: L Square
• Dimensions: 50 × 41 × 26 cm

Condition:
Good. The bag has been gently used. It does have scratching on the back and scuffs at the corners. The hardware has some scratches. Overall in quite good condition and can be treated at Hermès Spa.

Set:
Clochette (Bell), Lock and Keys

Verso — Black Outside, Blue Within

Verso is Hermès' term for a bag lined in a contrasting colour. Here the exterior reads classic black while the interior opens to a deep dark blue — an unexpected, private flash of colour every time the bag is used. This particular example carries the effect further: under certain light the exterior side panels themselves take on a blue cast while the rest of the bag stays black, so the piece shifts subtly depending on how the light falls. It is a genuinely rare configuration and the kind of nuance that defines a collector's HAC rather than a standard one.

name: Haut à Courroies leather weekend bag
description: 2025 Hermes HAC Birkin 40 in Etain Togo on Palladium Hardware. Haut à Courroies (HAC) — the original Hermès bag silhouette, predating the Birkin by nearly a century. Originally designed in the 1890s to carry riding saddles, The HAC is taller and more square than the standard Birkin 40, with shorter double rolled handles and a toggle closure instead of a turn-lock. Etain is a medium grey with warm undertones that sits between Gris Mouette (cooler) and Etoupe (warmer, more taupe) on the Hermès grey spectrum. Togo provides a textured grain with moderate structure. Palladium hardware reinforces the cool-neutral register. Tonal stitching. Interior lined in Etain Chèvre with no interior pockets. Never used: complete set of original packaging, dustbag, receipt, key and clochette.

name: Birkin 35 ostrich handbag
description:
Hermès Birkin 35 Chestnut Ostrich Leather – Gold Hardware (1995)

An extraordinary example of Hermès craftsmanship, this authentic Hermès Birkin 35 is handcrafted from luxurious Chestnut Ostrich leather and finished with elegant gold-plated hardware. Produced in 1995, this exceptional handbag combines timeless design with one of Hermès' most exclusive and coveted exotic leathers, making it a true collector's piece.

The rich Chestnut color is a warm, medium brown with subtle caramel undertones that beautifully complement the natural texture of ostrich leather and the brilliance of the gold hardware. This classic neutral shade transitions effortlessly from season to season and pairs easily with virtually any wardrobe.

Hermès Ostrich leather is renowned for its distinctive quill follicle pattern, creating a unique texture that makes every bag one of a kind. Exceptionally soft and lightweight, ostrich leather develops a beautiful patina over time while remaining remarkably durable. Highly prized by collectors, it is considered one of the finest exotic leathers produced by Hermès for its luxurious feel, rarity, and timeless appeal. Comes with clochette, padlock, keys and dustbag. SKU00140000

name: Haut à Courroies leather 24h bag
description:
HERMÈS HAC 50 (HAUT À COURROIES) NOIR

For sale is a rare Hermès HAC 50 (Haut à Courroies) in Noir. The HAC is considered the historical original model of the later Birkin Bag and is today one of the most sought-after bags for collectors and lovers of Hermès.

This piece is from 2013 and has been exclusively in my possession since its purchase. I am the first owner of the bag. With its generous size of 50 cm, the HAC was originally designed as a luxurious travel and weekender bag and embodies the traditional craftsmanship of Hermès in its most original form.

It is particularly noteworthy that the bag was officially at the Hermès Spa last year for assessment and care. The history is verifiable.

Condition:
The bag is in an overall good used condition with a beautiful patina. On the right side of the leather, there are visible changes, presumably caused by heat exposure. These do not represent structural damage to the leather but are visually present and are intentionally mentioned for transparency.

Inside, there is also a small burn mark or a small burn hole. This was checked during the Spa visit but could not be removed. Apart from that, the inner leather is still stable and not damaged.

Details:
• Hermès HAC 50 (Haut à Courroies)
• Color: Noir
• Year of Manufacture: 2013
• Size: 50 cm
• First ownership
• Hermès Spa history available
• Made in France
• Rare collector's model

description:
Hermes Kelly Au Galop 32 Indigo Blue Togo with Palladium HW - Limited Edition.

This magnificent handbag is truly unique, created as a limited-edition piece that is no longer produced. Its rarity places it among the most coveted designs, and one day, this Au Galop edition is destined to take its place within the Hermès Museum as a testament to timeless design and exclusivity.

name: Kelly 28 leather handbag
description:
Hermes Kelly Sellier 28 In Bleu Indigo Epsom With Gold Hardware Y Stamp

From 2020 (purchased August 2021), this classic handbag is absolutely stunning. It is crafted of Epsom leather in Bleu Indigo, a deep rich navy that borders on black, and features a leather top handle, an optional shoulder strap, and gold-plated hardware. The flap opens to a matching goatskin leather interior with zipper and patch pockets.

This preloved Kelly 28 is in very good condition. It has beautiful structure, protective film on all hardware with the exception of the shoulder strap and there are no visible scuffs. Photos were taken in different light to show color variation.

There are some creases on the back where the flap opens which are more prevalent on the right side. There are normal soft impressions in the interior and the shoulder strap has a “twist” or kink in it which appears to be from storage. There are very fine scratches on the hardware without film and some tarnishing on the plaque rivets, as well. The corners are super clean as is the interior.

Comes with removable shoulder strap, box (has wear), all dust bags, lock and keys, clochette, protective felt, care book and original receipt

name: Birkin 35 leather handbag
description:
Hermes Black Birkin 35 in Noir Togo Leather With Palladium Hardware

This stunning preloved Birkin 35 from late 2011 is in very good condition. The bag features rolled leather top handles, a frontal flap, a strap closure and Palladium hardware. The top flap opens to a matching goatskin leather interior with zipper and patch pockets. Noir is one of the most coveted colors and is a must have in any collection.

This preowned Birkin has been lovingly cared for. There are some hairline scratches on the main hardware and heavier scratches on the four clou. The plaques look like mirrors. There is also some normal wear on the glazing (flap and inside handles). The interior is clean but does have some pressure impressions and scuffs. There are some very mild scuffs in the leather and some areas on the back that appear lighter at certain angles, but are not visible under a macro lens (see photo). These areas may have fat spew (a natural occurrence) as they appear between the grain vs. on top of the grain.

Comes with box (has some wear), dust bags, clochette, keys and lock, rain coat and silk insert.

name: Kelly 32 leather handbag
description:
Hermès Kelly 32 Sellier – Chestnut Ostrich Leather – 1998

A timeless icon of French craftsmanship, this Hermès Kelly 32 Sellier is exquisitely crafted from luxurious ostrich leather in a rich chestnut brown hue. Coveted for its distinctive quill pattern, ostrich leather is exceptionally soft, lightweight, and highly durable, developing a beautiful patina with age.

The structured Sellier construction showcases the Kelly's elegant silhouette with crisp edges and meticulous hand-stitched saddle seams. Gold-tone hardware beautifully complements the warm chestnut leather, while the signature turn-lock closure secures a spacious leather-lined interior suitable for everyday essentials.

This example dates to 1998 and includes its removable shoulder strap, allowing it to be carried by hand or worn comfortably over the shoulder. A true investment piece, the Kelly 32 remains one of Hermès' most sought-after handbag sizes, offering both timeless sophistication and practical versatility. Comes with padlock, keys, dustbag and removable strap. Very good vintage condition with visible color fading beneath the front flap and sangles, likely due to age and sun exposure over time. Because the affected area is concealed when the bag is closed, it does not impact the bag's overall appearance while being carried. The exterior panels, handles, and strap remain attractive, and the ostrich leather is supple with a well-preserved quill pattern.

name: HAC à dos leather backpack
description:
Hac à Dos GM – Veau Barenia Faubourg, Fauve (H083848CK34)
The Hac à Dos is among the most considered pieces in the modern Hermès lineup — rooted in the DNA of the legendary Haut à Courroies, reimagined as a backpack for daily life. This GM (Grand Modèle) example is crafted in Barenia Faubourg, the most prestigious leather in the Hac à Dos range and among the most coveted in the entire Hermès universe.

Barenia Faubourg is exclusive to Hermès, associated with the storied Maison at 24 Faubourg Saint-Honoré. Smooth and waxy to the touch, it develops a rich, individual patina over time — a quality that separates it from every other leather in the house.

The colorway is Fauve (CK34) — a warm, luminous honey-tan that works across every season and context. Palladium hardware provides a clean, lasting finish.

This piece was purchased directly from the Hermès boutique at 17 Rue de Sèvres, Paris in May 2023 at the then-boutique price of €8,450 EUR. It has been barely used and was recently professionally conditioned at an official Hermès boutique spa — the leather is in exceptional health and perfectly prepared for its next chapter of wear and patina development. Current retail for this configuration now stands at approximately $13,600 USD, reflecting significant price appreciation since purchase.

Hand-stitched throughout

Dating from 2019, this classic black Kelly 28 is absolutely beautiful. It is made from very rare smooth Sombrero leather (matte version of Box) in Black and has a top leather handle, an optional shoulder strap and gold-plated hardware. The flap opens to a matching goat leather interior with zipped and slip pockets.

This pre-owned Kelly 28 is in very good condition. It has a beautiful structure, protective film on all the hardware with light scuffs on the leather.

There are some natural creases on the leather and some tarnish on the rivets of the plate. There is very light wear on the piping and no wear on the corners that we can see.

Comes with a removable shoulder strap, a box, all dust bags, a padlock and keys, a clochette, a protective felt and a care booklet.

name: Birkin 35 leather handbag
description:
Hermès Birkin 35 Togo Leather – Tabac Camel – Palladium Hardware (2012)
A timeless icon of luxury, this authentic Hermès Birkin 35 is handcrafted from luxurious Togo calfskin leather in the coveted Tabac Camel color, beautifully complemented by elegant palladium-plated hardware. Produced in 2012, this sophisticated Birkin embodies Hermès' legendary craftsmanship and enduring style.

Tabac Camel is a highly sought-after, now discontinued Hermès color known for its refined tawny tan-beige appearance. Often compared to the soft warmth of milk tea, it belongs to Hermès' classic family of natural neutral tones. This versatile shade transitions effortlessly through every season and pairs beautifully with palladium hardware, creating an understated yet unmistakably luxurious look. Its timeless neutrality makes it easy to style with both casual and formal wardrobes.

Crafted from Togo leather, one of Hermès' most popular and durable leathers, this Birkin features a lightly grained texture with a soft, supple feel while maintaining excellent structure. Togo is prized for its resistance to scratches, ability to hold its shape over time, and relatively lightweight nature, making it an ideal leather for everyday use. The natural grain also helps disguise minor signs of wear, ensuring the bag remains beautiful for years to come.

The spacious 35 cm size offers exceptional functionality, making it perfect for daily wear, travel, or work while preserving the unmistakable elegance of the Birkin silhouette. Date code square P. Comes with dustbag, clochette, padlock, keys and raincoat.

name: Kelly 35 leather handbag
description:
This is an authentic HERMES leather Kelly 35 in black. A single rolled leather top handle is secured with polished gold plated hardware and an optional leather shoulder strap is included. The traditional gold Kelly turn lock secures the small flap with a padlock. A hanging leather key clochette accessorizes this handbag. The interior features two flat pockets, as well as a zippered pocket, both in chevre goatskin leather. Date code square F (made in 2002). 
Chèvre de Coromandel is a luxurious goat leather that Hermès has historically used on Kelly bags, especially on vintage pieces. It is prized for its elegant appearance and remarkable durability. This leather features a very fine, tight grain with subtle natural striations, giving the surface a slightly textured look while maintaining a soft natural sheen. On a Kelly bag, Chèvre de Coromandel creates a beautifully structured silhouette while remaining lightweight, making the bag comfortable to carry despite its refined construction. One of the most desirable qualities of Chèvre is its exceptional resistance to scratches and wear. The leather holds its shape extremely well over time, which helps the Kelly maintain its iconic sharp lines and crisp edges. It also develops a gentle patina with age, enhancing the richness and depth of the leather. Collectors appreciate Chèvre de Coromandel Kelly bags for their combination of durability, elegance, and rarity, as Hermès now more commonly uses Chèvre Mysore in modern production. Overall, a Kelly crafted in Chèvre de Coromandel offers the perfect balance of refinement, structure, and long-lasting beauty, making it a highly sought-after leather among Hermès enthusiasts.

name: Birkin 35 leather handbag
description:
This is an authentic HERMES courchevel Birkin 35 in ebene. Hermès Ébène (Ebony) is a deep, rich, and timeless dark brown shade, often considered the closest brown to black, making it a sophisticated, versatile neutral. It has subtle warm red or mahogany undertones, appearing as a dark espresso shade, and is highly regarded as a softer alternative to Noir.
This iconic handbag features rolled leather top handles, a front flap with strap closure, and polished gold plated hardware. The top flap opens to a matching brown chèvre leather interior with a zipper pocket and patch pockets. Stamp circle Z.

A timeless icon of luxury, this 2006 Hermès Birkin 35 is crafted in the house's coveted Gold Swift leather and paired with elegant palladium hardware, creating a refined combination that is both classic and effortlessly sophisticated.

Hermès Gold is one of the brand's most iconic and enduring colors—a rich, warm caramel tan that complements every wardrobe and season. Crafted in Swift leather, this Birkin has a smooth, supple feel with a subtle sheen that beautifully enhances the depth and vibrancy of the color. Swift leather is lightweight, luxurious to the touch, and known for developing a graceful character over time while showcasing Hermès' impeccable craftsmanship.

The spacious 35cm size offers exceptional practicality, making it ideal for everyday use, travel, or work while maintaining the Birkin's unmistakable structured silhouette.

This bag is accompanied by its Hermès dust bag, clochette, padlock (cadena), and keys, completing the classic Birkin presentation.

An enduring investment piece, this Gold Swift Birkin 35 embodies the timeless elegance, exceptional craftsmanship, and lasting desirability that have made Hermès one of the world's most sought-after luxury maisons.

name: Birkin 35 leather handbag
description:
This is an authentic HERMES courchevel Birkin 35 in Rough H. This iconic handbag features rolled leather top handles, a front flap with strap closure, and polished gold plated hardware. The top flap opens to a matching brown chèvre leather interior with a zipper pocket and patch pockets. Stamp square B. 
No Hermès color embodies the brand’s history like Rouge H. Introduced nearly a century ago, it remains the House’s signature shade — a deep, wine-inflected red that’s equal parts heritage and modern luxury. In certain lights, Rouge H leans toward mahogany; in others, a rich cherry-burgundy. Its brown undertones make it endlessly wearable, pairing beautifully with neutrals like Gold, Etoupe, and Etain, or with warm accents like Barenia and Chocolate. Collectors adore Rouge H in Box Calf, Epsom, and Courchevel leather — especially with gold hardware, where the shade’s depth and warmth truly come alive. This color is often seen as “the” Hermès red: sophisticated, understated, and deeply Parisian.

description:
This is an authentic HERMES Swift Birkin 35 in Pelouse. Hermès Swift leather (formerly Gulliver) is a smooth, fine-grained calfskin reintroduced in 2005, prized for its buttery-soft texture, slouchy structure, and exceptional ability to absorb vibrant colors.  This sophisticated handbag is expertly crafted from green smooth, supple leather. The bag features rolled leather top handles, a frontal flap, a hanging clochette, and polished palladium hardware, including a turn lock, padlock, and key. The top flap opens to a matching leather interior with a zipper and patch pockets. Date code square M. 
Hermès Pelouse emerges as one of the most evocatively verdant and expressively pastoral hues in the luxury house’s distinguished color portfolio. This sophisticated, lawn-inspired shade encapsulates a compelling landscape narrative—simultaneously referencing the manicured perfection of cultivated grounds and the refined natural splendor of European garden traditions—creating a color that projects curated botanical elegance while maintaining the sublime execution synonymous with the heritage brand. Pelouse occupies a distinctive position in the Hermès spectrum—a refined, landscape-derived hue with remarkable chromatic vitality that draws inspiration from both aristocratic garden heritage and contemporary appreciation of manicured natural aesthetics while embodying the meticulous sophistication expected from this storied maison.
What distinguishes Pelouse is its exceptional landscape resonance and cultivated authenticity. Unlike more conventionally green Hermès colors such as the raw Vert Cru or the deep Vert Foncé, Pelouse offers a more distinctly curated quality with substantial chromatic vibrancy that gives it a sophisticated, almost horticulturally precise character. This perfectly calibrated color profile allows Pelouse to function as both a heritage landscape statement and a versatile expression of refined natural cultivation—an evocative choice for the Hermès client who values colors with horticultural significance and authentic garden-inspired refinement.

name: Kelly Monaco Vintage leather handbag
description: An exceptionally rare and historically significant piece, this Hermès Kelly Monaco dates to 1958, representing one of the earliest and most distinctive variations of the iconic Kelly bag. Crafted from black box leather and accented with gold-plated hardware, this vintage Hermès piece reflects the refined craftsmanship and elegance that defined the house during the mid-20th century.The Kelly Monaco is a lesser-known but highly collectible interpretation of the classic Kelly design. Produced in very limited numbers during the 1950s and early 1960s, the style is believed to have been created for the elegant lifestyle of the Monaco and Riviera clientele, where smaller, refined evening and day bags were favored. Today, surviving examples are seldom seen on the market, making the model particularly desirable among Hermès collectors and vintage enthusiasts.The bag retains the classic turn-lock closure, structured body, and refined proportions that have made the Kelly one of the most celebrated handbags in fashion history. The rich black calf leather has developed beautiful character over time, while the gold hardware provides a warm contrast that enhances the timeless sophistication of the design.All parts of the bag are original dating back to 1958. name: Kelly 35 leather handbag
description:
Hermès Kelly 35 in Indigo Courchevel Leather with Gold Hardware – 1995
A timeless and sophisticated vintage Hermès Kelly 35 crafted in rich Indigo navy Courchevel leather and finished with classic gold hardware. This structured silhouette showcases the elegant lines and refined craftsmanship that made the Kelly one of the most iconic handbags in fashion history. The deep navy tone pairs effortlessly with both casual and elevated looks, while the Courchevel leather offers excellent durability with its lightly textured finish and shape retention. Features the signature front flap with turn-lock closure, top handle, clochette, lock and keys, and removable shoulder strap for versatile wear. Stamp: Circle Y (1995 era)
A chic and increasingly collectible vintage Kelly perfect for travel, everyday elegance, or the seasoned Hermès collector.

name: Kelly 32 leather handbag
description:
The 1991 Hermès Kelly 32 Sellier is a timeless classic crafted in Crinoline and Box Calf leather in an elegant beige colorway. The structured Sellier construction showcases Hermès' renowned craftsmanship, featuring sharp lines, meticulous hand-stitched saddle seams, and polished gold-plated hardware. The iconic Kelly turn-lock closure is accompanied by its clochette, lock, and keys, adding to the bag's enduring appeal.

At 32cm, this Kelly offers a spacious interior while maintaining the sophisticated proportions that have made the style a favorite among collectors for decades. Combining exceptional craftsmanship, practicality, and investment-worthy desirability, this vintage Kelly is a remarkable addition to any Hermès collection.

About Crinoline:
Crinoline is a distinctive Hermès material that combines durable woven horsehair canvas with leather trim, most commonly Box Calf leather. The horsehair weave creates a subtle textured appearance and lightweight structure while offering excellent durability. Produced primarily in the 1980s and 1990s, Crinoline pieces are highly sought after today for their rarity, unique texture, and classic equestrian heritage. The combination of Crinoline and Box Calf gives the bag a refined contrast between the smooth leather and the woven body, making it a particularly collectible vintage Hermès design. Date code circle U. Comes with removable strap, clochette, padlock and keys. Corners have been color retouched.

name: Kelly 32 leather handbag

Hermès Kelly 32 Rouge Indien Box Calf Leather Gold Hardware, 1991 (○U Stamp) This elegant Vintage Hermès Kelly 32 is crafted from luxurious Box Calf leather and accented with gold hardware, showcasing the timeless sophistication of the Hermès house. Color rouge indien is Warm, earthy red with a slight brown undertone, Often looks like a deep terracotta or brick red. Stamped ○U (1991), this Kelly features tonal stitching, a front toggle closure, clochette with lock and keys, and a single rolled top handle—making it perfect for both everyday elegance and formal occasions. The interior is lined in matching leather and offers one zip pocket with an Hermès-engraved pull and two open pockets on the opposite side for organization. A true Hermès classic, this Kelly embodies timeless Parisian craftsmanship and vintage charm—an essential addition for any collector or lover of refined luxury.

This Hermès Haut à Courroies 32 (HAC 32) is crafted from Courchevel leather with gold hardware, featuring tonal stitching, a front flap with the signature toggle (turn-lock) closure and dual rolled handles.

The Haut à Courroies, the original Hermès travel bag from which the Birkin was derived, is characterized by its taller profile and shorter handles, giving it a distinctly structured and elegant silhouette. In the 32 cm size, the HAC offers the refined proportions of a Kelly or Birkin in a compact, architectural form ideal for everyday use.

The Courchevel leather—a fine-grained, embossed calfskin—is known for its lightweight yet durable finish, subtle sheen, and excellent resistance to scratches and moisture. description:
This is the Kelly at its most iconic size and silhouette: the 35cm, in structured box calf leather, finished with gold-tone hardware that plays beautifully against the deep burgundy ("Red Gold") color. Box calf is the classic Hermès Sellier leather, which is exactly what gives the Kelly its architectural, sculpted shape. This is the leather purists look for.

The details:
Size: 35cm W x 25cm H x 14cm D, with a 27cm handle and a 90cm shoulder strap — genuinely convertible between hand-carry and cross-body/shoulder wear

Hardware: Gold-tone, including the signature turn-lock, clochette, and padlock with two keys

Interior: Three interior pockets, a practical touch for a bag this size

Full accessory set: Comes with the dust bag, shoulder strap, cadena lock, two keys, and clochette.

Serial: OY

Condition: This is a pre-owned bag with visible wear - scratches, some discoloration, a slightly out-of-shape handle, minor edge wear, and a corner thread.

Why that's actually an opportunity: A brand-new Kelly 35 in this leather and hardware combination would run well into five figures, with a waitlist to match. This one gets you into the bag — the shape, the craftsmanship, the presence — at a meaningful discount, precisely because it's been carried and loved rather than kept in a closet. Box calf also has a way of aging into character rather than just looking tired; a little softness and patina on a Kelly often reads as heritage, not damage. For a buyer who wants the real bag now rather than a wait-list promise later, this is the value case.

An extraordinary vintage Hermès Kelly 35 crafted in classic Box Calf leather in rich Ebene (dark chocolate) brown, dating to 1993. 
Box Calf from the 1990s is highly coveted for its structured silhouette, glossy finish, and the way it develops a refined patina over time. Finding a Kelly of this era in excellent condition, with clean corners, strong structure, and beautiful surface sheen, is increasingly rare. Many examples from this period show significant wear or loss of shape—this one presents beautifully and has been exceptionally preserved.
The 35cm size offers elegant proportions—large enough for everyday sophistication, yet timeless and ladylike in silhouette. The deep Ebene shade is one of Hermès’ most classic and versatile browns, pairing effortlessly with both neutrals and richer tones. Comes with removable strap,clochette, padlock, keys and dustbag.

name: Haut à Courroies leather handbag
description:
Hermès Haut À Courroies 32 (HAC 32) – Box Calf Leather in Red with Gold Hardware – 1995

This exquisite Hermès HAC 32 is crafted from luxurious Box Calf leather in the rich and sophisticated red color. Paired with Gold hardware, this 1995 piece embodies heritage Hermès craftsmanship. Hermès Box Leather is one of the house’s most iconic and historic leathers, prized for its smooth surface, refined sheen, and timeless elegance.
Originally developed for Hermès saddlery, Box leather is made from high-quality calfskin that is vegetable-tanned and polished to create a firm, glossy finish. The result is a leather with a sleek, structured appearance and a subtle natural shine that gives Hermès bags a very classic, sophisticated look.

Box leather is known for its smooth, almost glass-like surface, which highlights the purity of the leather and the craftsmanship of the bag. Over time, it develops a beautiful patina, becoming softer and richer in tone with age. Because of its firm structure, it helps bags such as the HAC maintain their elegant shape.

The HAC is the historic predecessor to the Birkin, prized for its structured proportions and strong equestrian heritage.

An extraordinarily rare and exquisite Hermès Kelly 40 in luminous Gold courchevel leather, adorned with matching gold hardware. This magnificent statement piece showcases the maison's mastery of color and material, with the warm, radiant tone of both leather and metal creating a harmonious composition of unparalleled sophistication.

Hermès Courchevel Leather is a lightweight, durable, embossed calfskin known for its crisp texture and excellent shape retention. Unlike naturally grained leathers, courchevel receives its distinctive crosshatched grain through an embossing process, creating a refined, structured appearance that is highly resistant to scratches and everyday wear.

Hihgly prized for its practicality, durability, and sophisticated appearance, courchevel remains one of Hermès' most popular and enduring leather choices.

name: Kelly Dépêches leather handbag
description:
AUTH Hermes Kelly Depeches Briefcase, Rouge H, RARE BOX LEATHER!

Coveted Hermès Kelly Depeches handbag! This is not the normal size 34 or 25 style like you see EVERYWHERE. This is the very rare Size 38 version. This also isn't the common Epsom or Togo leather version; this is in beautiful BOX leather.

This is the epitome of Hermès craftsmanship, and traces its silhouette and roots to the very first Kelly bags from 70 years ago; worn by Hollywood elite, royalty, and First Ladies. A Kelly Depeches in this size and this color AND in BOX LEATHER is virtually impossible to find. This is the dream combination! Get this one while you can!

This bag is of course 100% guaranteed AUTHENTIC, but do realize it is used and may have some flaws. I purchased it and quickly realized I already had too many similarly sized bags, including another Kelly Depeches and other luxury French fashion houses bags. So my loss is your gain!

Its features include:

-Leather rolled top handle
-Smooth box leather
-Palladium Kelly closure and hardware
-the option to add a removable shoulder strap...which transforms this iconic style into a multi-functional piece; switch from a classic tote/briefcase to a crossbody or shoulder bag in one fell swoop.

*Note: clochette and lock/keys not included.

Being Hermès, the craftsmanship is impeccable and much attention to detail was given. Just holding it your hand or wearing it across your body, you can feel the sheer luxury.

If you aren't buying it for yourself, it would make a fabulous gift!


Please view all pics closely and ask all questions/additional photos prior to bidding. *There may be small imperfections, as this is box leather it shows it character; but that no bearing on the overall beauty of the exterior.

Buy with confidence as I have listed and sold countless luxury goods. I am a connoisseur so all of my items are 100% AUTHENTIC and personally curated/purchased/owned by me.

name: Kelly 32 leather handbag
description:
A Kelly 32 from 1962. Not a recent collector's item — a bag that has survived over sixty years and still bears the full Hermès signature: Gulliver returned leather in a warm, deep orange-camel, stamped R.
This is the very definition of a heritage bag.

Provenance & Authenticity
• Stamp R (1962) — authentic
• Went through Hermès after-sales service — receipt document included
• Authenticated by Vestiaire Collective — verification tag present
• Sold with: Hermès dustbag, Hermès orange bag, Hermès spring-summer magazine, non-original shoulder strap, original clochette with its two keys.

Condition: fair for its age — sold as is

This Kelly has been lived in. The leather and corners call for a restoration — care and handle replacement. Specialized artisans were consulted: expect between €1,175 and €1,250 for a complete restoration by expert hands.
The potential is all there. The buyer who knows what they are doing gets an authentic vintage Kelly 32, with its accessories and its history.

Crafted from premium box calfskin in a commanding, vivid red colour and anchored by its signature horseshoe gold buckle, this generous GM edition stands as an ultimate statement of sophisticated power and timeless, quiet luxury.

Hardware: Radiant gold-toned hardware, highlighted by the signature D-shaped horseshoe buckle closure.
Interior: Luxuriously lined in smooth, contrast leather; configured with a spacious single compartment that includes one zip pocket, one slip pocket, and an integrated key lanyard for flawless daily organisation.
Features: Outfitted with a structured, rolled-leather top handle, protective base metal feet, and a detachable leather shoulder strap for seamless versatility.

name: Leather tote
description:
White topstitching gives this adorable Hermès Gold Cleménce Picotin Lock 18 a casual flair! This square-shaped, open-topped tote can be given a little definition when you cinch in the sides with the leash that can be secured with the gold-tone lock and keys. It is unlined with no pockets, but the bottom interior and exterior are leather, and the dual flat handles have a drop of 5 inches. In great condition from 2022 (Z stamp), it comes with a dustbag, box, and partial plastic on the hardware, and it has a bit of wear on the feet. Those gold feet help this gal stand on her own!

name: Halzan leather handbag
description:
The bold color of this Hermès Red Clemènce Halzan 31 takes it from merely gorgeous to off-the-charts stunning! Already considered a casual bag, the white top stitching adds to the vibe of this three-way. Paired with palladium hardware, it can be worn tall when carried by the 4-inch-drop stirrup-shaped handles, rocked as a clutch when the top is folded down and the buckle closure engaged, or slung crossbody when the leather strap with an 18-inch drop is attached. The tonal leather-lined interior has one slide pocket while each exterior bag face has an two more slide pockets. In great condition and stamped with a T, it comes with a dustbag and has a bit of wear on the hardware, as well as darkening near the buckle. The Halzan is like getting three bags for the price of one!

name: Della leather crossbody bag
description:
Hermès’ Mini Black Epsom Della Cavalleria is a sleek, equestrian-inspired crossbody that blends structured elegance with everyday practicality! Crafted from black leather with palladium hardware and an adjustable shoulder strap shown with a 20-inch drop, this compact silhouette features a curved flap secured by a horsebit clasp that lifts to open. A slide pocket on the back adds convenience, while the black leather-lined interior includes one more slide pocket for essentials. In very good condition from 2023 (B stamp), it comes with a dustbag and box and has wear on the buckle hardware and inside. This polished mini delivers understated sophistication in a versatile, modern form!

 In der Kollektion verwendet seit: 2018
 Optische Eigenschaften: Unregelmäßige, aber harmonische kleine Narbung

 Hand: Fest und weich
 Entwicklung im Laufe der Zeit: Starke Neigung zur Patina

* Box Calf leather
* Rich red exterior and interior
* Decorative leather lacing with gold-tone tassels
* Hidden snap closure
* Gold-tone hardware
* Interior zip pocket with ÉCLAIR zipper
* Removable shoulder strap attachment points (strap not included)
* Made in France

Measurements

* Depth: 2.5 in (6.4 cm)

Condition
Very good vintage condition with expected signs of age, including light surface scratches, minor corner and edge wear, and gentle creasing consistent with careful use over time.  Entwicklung im Laufe der Zeit: Es wird biegsamer

name: President cloth travel bag
description:
This authentic pre-owned 1996 Louis Vuitton Vintage President's Briefcase perfectly exemplifies the brand's timeless elegance and exceptional craftsmanship. Crafted from iconic Monogram coated canvas, this hard-sided trunk is accented with classic brass hardware, a secure snap closure, and decorative LV logo trim, combining luxury and functionality. Its lid opens to reveal a spacious and elegant interior with a divider and a slip pocket on the lid, ideal for storing documents and personal belongings. Although the original lock is missing, its serial number allows you to have a custom-made replacement made to preserve the security and authenticity of your bag. This piece is in good overall condition, showing only minor wear to the corners. The cowhide leather handle and luggage tag show natural discoloration, giving it a distinguished vintage character. Ideal for collectors and connoisseurs, this briefcase trunk combines practicality, refinement, and historical significance, making it a valuable addition to any luxury collection. 

*Brand: Louis Vuitton 
*Color: Brown Louis Vuitton monogram canvas with brass hardware 
*Approximate Dimensions: 43.2 cm W x 18.3 cm H x 35.6 cm D 
*Condition: This trunk is in very good condition, with minor wear to the corners, cowhide handle, and luggage tag. The key is missing, but you can use the serial number on the lock to have another one made 
*Made in France 

*Guaranteed Authentic

name: Bolide leather satchel
description:
This Hermès Etoupe Sikkim Bolide 35 is a Relax—that’s Hermès speak for slouchy! As you might notice, the Relax has no oval patch on the front face for monogramming and does not come with a leather shoulder strap. This white-stitched lovely has a lockable top zipper that opens to cream-colored chevron fabric lining and two slide pockets. The dual rolled handles with a 4-inch drop make for a comfortable hand or arm carry. In Good condition and stamped with a P in a square, it comes with a lock, keys, a clochette, and a dustbag, and has light wear on the corners and edges, wear on the hardware and inside, the handles curve to one side from storage, and it needs an airing out. Lest you think this girl is a total slouch, her five palladium feet keep her upright and looking good!

Crafted from black leather with palladium hardware, it features an adjustable webbing strap shown with a 19-inch drop for effortless crossbody wear, along with the signature perforated H and a small snapped flap above the open interior. description:
Hermès’ Barenia Evelyne PM I 29 is a very cool bag that’s a blast from the past and would be great for just knocking around! Paired with white contrast stitching and gold-tone hardware, it has a small snapped flap that secures over the top and an unlined interior with one slide pocket inside. name: Mini Evelyne leather crossbody bag
description:
Hermès Mini Evelyne TPM 16 Amazone — Feu/Feu | Taurillon Clémence | Gold Hardware

A stunning Hermès Mini Evelyne TPM 16 Amazone in the highly coveted Feu colorway — a fiery, vibrant red-orange that is bold, sophisticated, and incredibly wearable. The tonal Feu/Feu combination means both the bag body and the canvas strap share the same striking color, making this a truly eye-catching piece.

Has been stored in a pet-free and smoke-free, temperature and humidity-controlled environment.

The Cityslide line is designed to be highly versatile, featuring an adjustable strap so it can be worn around the waist or as a crossbody bag.

Taurillon Cristobal is a very fine-grained, nearly smooth calfskin leather used primarily in Hermès men's bags and small leather goods. Named after Christopher Columbus, it is highly valued for its supple, soft hand-feel and subtle, matte finish that is usually featured in dark, muted colors. name: Cotteville cloth 24h bag
description:
This miniature suitcase, over 45 years old and in incredible condition, is the smallest version of the Cotteville suitcase (40 cm).
A limited edition from the 1970s, the Cotteville suitcase, a true cult object from the House of Louis Vuitton, was redesigned and updated to reflect the style of the era: a square handle, a simplified lever-lock mechanism, and the removal of half of the original trims to achieve the 70s style. This very limited series was produced in the mid-70s alongside the classic historical model (which was not replaced by this version). It responded to customer demand for the latest fashion. Ideal for collectors looking to create a collection of pieces from different eras that represent the history of Louis Vuitton.

description: Moynat reimagines its travel bags with a contemporary twist, incorporating elements cherished by the House. Each bag reflects symbolism found in the House's archives, featuring evenly spaced pyramid metal pieces, wide dyed leather edges, goatskin linings, and clasps inspired by classic travel bag designs. The lightness inherited from the "English Trunk" made of amlode (1873), the elegant, curved design of the legendary "Limousine Trunk" (1902), and the ingenious curves of the "Wheel Trunk" (1906), along with a sense of proportion and meticulous finishing, are all inexhaustible sources of inspiration for Nicholas Knightly, Creative Director of Moynat Paris.

The Hermès Herbag bag is a well-known design that offers a blend of practicality and luxury, often featuring a combination of canvas and leather. It is a versatile bag that can be carried as a tote or a shoulder bag, making it a popular choice for everyday use among discerning fashion enthusiasts.
The design draws inspiration from vintage luggage and equestrian styles, reflecting Hermès' heritage.
Introduced as a more casual alternative to some of their iconic leather bags, the Herbag gained popularity for its durable toile canvas and elegant leather accents. The bag typically includes a removable pouch and features the signature Hermès turn-lock closure, often adorned with the brand's name and origin. Its adaptability and timeless design have cemented its status as a sought-after accessory in the luxury market.

name: Leather travel bag
description:
Authentic Hermès Drag Travel Bag. Very rare. Beautiful and timeless. Circa 1988. 55cm, vintage, gold leather and canvas, notched flap, double handle.

Condition: This piece was obviously very well loved. There are spots, water marks, general wear, cracks in leather, missing foot on bottom, but is still a solid heirloom and has lots of life left. Base has a removable insert.
Overall fair vintage condition.


​The "Drag" takes its name from a type of horse-drawn carriage, staying true to Hermès’ equestrian roots. In the 1980s, these were the ultimate understated travel statement—designed for people who wanted the craftsmanship of the Rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré without the obvious logos of the era.

This was the same year they celebrated their 150th anniversary (with the "Year of the Exotic" theme), and the quality of the Toile canvas and gold leather from this specific year is highly regarded for its durability.

The leather is likely Vache Naturelle with a patina and some water and oil marks.
 
Fantastic weekender or large carry-on.

 Wie seine Namensgebung in Anlehnung an die gleichnamige südindische Stadt vermuten lässt, stammt das unbehandelte Leder aus Indien. Sein Markenzeichen ist seine besondere Narbung, die durch die Chagrin-Technik erhalten wird. Dabei wird das Leder auf der Narbenseite aneinander gerieben, um die Narbung auszurichten. Dies kann in einer Richtung erfolgen, um ein feines Linienmuster zu erhalten, oder aber in verschiedenen Richtungen.
 In der Kollektion verwendet seit: 1990er Jahre
 Optische Eigenschaften: Unregelmäßige aber harmonische Narbung, leichter Glanz, der die natürlichen Eigenschaften des Ziegenleders offenbart
 Oberflächenbeschaffenheit: Eher trocken, wird im Laufe der Zeit weicher
 Hand: Biegsam
 Entwicklung im Laufe der Zeit: Wird geschmeidiger und seidig

The Atlas 42 is a rare east-west silhouette known for its understated sophistication, spacious interior, and architectural detailing inspired by Hermès’ iconic equestrian design language.

This generously sized shoulder bag features dual rolled leather handles, side belt accents, a top zip closure, and a roomy interior ideal for everyday luxury, travel, or workwear styling. The elongated silhouette gives the piece a sleek, modern feel while maintaining the relaxed elegance Hermès is known for.

Excellent pre-loved condition with light signs of wear consistent with careful use. A timeless and increasingly hard-to-find Hermès silhouette that blends practicality with quiet luxury.

Perfect for collectors seeking a rare Hermès travel or city bag with the effortless appeal of the current east-west silhouette trend.

description:

Vintage piece from 2003, carefully kept by its first owner.
Original Delvaux certificate of origin included with the bag.

Features
	•	Baltimore GM Trotteur model (large size)
	•	Grained Taurillon calf leather, Houblon colour
	•	Signature Delvaux 'D' charm
	•	Tohpo magnetic clasp
	•	Delvaux Bruxelles — Handmade in Belgium hot stamp
	•	Signature Delvaux 'D' interior zip pull
	•	Camel suede lining
	•	One flexible main handle

Condition
Very good general condition after 22 years, leather is well-preserved, structure intact, colour is intense and even.

Main handle is functional, structure intact, original stitching in place. Marked patina from use typical of a 22-year-old vintage item: marks and bending visible on the fold area, scattered micro-marks along its length.

Bottom of the bag: central surface in good condition. Light signs of use and more marked patina on the edge piping (where it rests), normal for a 22-year-old vintage item.

Suede lining: normal signs of use for a vintage item of this age, structure intact, no holes or tears.

Slight crushing / wrinkling of the leather around the clasp's rivet.

Accessories included
	•	Original Delvaux certificate of origin (Michel 2 Liège, 27.12.03)
	•	Original Delvaux mirror in matching Houblon leather pouch. The mirror surface has silver oxidation spots normal for its age.

Why this piece
A carefully preserved bag: intact structure, preserved leather, original stitching in place — a rare quality of conservation for a vintage item of this age.
An ideal piece for a Delvaux collector or a lover of authenticated vintage.
A bag from a Belgian Maison, handmade, traceable to its original boutique — a rare selling point on the second-hand market.
The Houblon colour is iconic of the early 2000s Delvaux collections and has become very rare on the pre-owned market.

First introduced as a fresh spin on the Hermès Herbag, the Hermès Herbag Cabas MM brings effortless chic to everyday life. Think of it as the Herbag’s laid-back cousin - same signature blend of leather and canvas, but with a more open silhouette that’s all about ease and versatility.

The Vache Hunter leather trim adds that unmistakable Hermès polish and the Canvas has a nice distinguished pattern. There’s no flap or clasp here - just clean lines, refined craftsmanship, and plenty of room for your daily essentials. It’s the kind of bag that feels right at home in a coffee shop, an art gallery, or tucked into your airplane seatback pocket.

-

All items in our collection undergo a thorough inspection to determine their current condition. After inspection, each item receives one of the following grades:

Grade A: New or as New

The item is new or like new, as if it just walked out of the boutique

Grade AB: Very Good Condition

The item has been well cared for and looks very good. There are limited & very light signs of wear. 

Grade B: Good Condition

The item shows visible signs of use consistent with regular wear, such as minor scuffs or surface marks, but remains fully functional and free from major damage or defects.

Product Description
This crossbody bag from the prestigious Italian house Loro Piana is the definition of "quiet luxury." Made from exquisite grained calfskin, it stands out for its supple yet durable texture and its vibrant caramel brown hue, a versatile color that enhances any outfit, from a casual day look to a more formal style.


The design features a triple gusseted compartment structure, which allows for impeccable organization without losing its slim and sophisticated silhouette. The attention to detail is maximal, incorporating silver-finish hardware that subtly contrasts with the warmth of the leather.


Design Details and Finishes
• Brand: Loro Piana.

• Shoulder Strap: Adjustable leather shoulder strap, designed for maximum comfort on the shoulder or across the body.
Condition of the Item


• General Condition: Fair. Visible signs of wear are apparent but do not affect the functionality of the bag in any way.
• Exterior: The leather maintains its original structure and grain with excellent shine. Minimal signs of use are visible on the edges and the zipper pull, typical of a carefully maintained second-hand piece.
• Hardware: In very good condition, retaining its original silver shine with imperceptible micro-scratches.


Why invest in this piece
Loro Piana is synonymous with the best raw materials in the world. Acquiring this bag is not just a bet on style, but also on durability. Its functional three-section design makes it the ideal companion for those who seek practicality without giving up the exclusivity of Italian craftsmanship.

description:
Elevate your luxury vintage collection with this exceptional, authentic archival piece from La Maison Delvaux, the world’s oldest fine leather luxury house (founded in Brussels in 1829).
Dating back to the 1990s, this highly collectible model features a striking, minimalist oval-shaped body paired with high-utility architecture. Crafted from Delvaux's legendary, heavy-grained calfskin leather in a timeless chestnut/cognac brown shade, it is designed to hold its structural silhouette beautifully while developing an elegant natural patina over time.

This piece functions beautifully as a Top-Handle Bag using the bold, integrated leather cutout at the top. On the reverse side, dual slim leather straps allow it to transform seamlessly into a high-fashion, hands-free Backpack.

The exterior back pocket is equipped with a solid, genuine vintage brass zipper pull custom-molded into Delvaux's iconic "D" logo silhouette. 
It features a horizontal, zip-closed compartment hidden directly on the back panel.
Wrapped in robust leather piping that reinforces its rounded, sculptural mid-century form. It has a premium, heavy-duty zipper that glides smoothly along the top curve of the oval body to reveal a generous main compartment.

Internal Authenticity Markings: Stamped with the authentic, unfaded original gold foil hot stamp reading: "MODELE DEPOSE — DELVAUX BRUXELLES — Handmade in France". Note: The rare "Handmade in France" text denotes production inside Delvaux's highly specialized French historical ateliers.

name: Cashmere pull
description:
Iconic Loro Piana sweater with a half-zip closure (Quarter-Zip), made from the brand's most exclusive and noble yarn: Baby Cashmere. A timeless garment, an emblem of "quiet luxury", famous for its unparalleled softness, lightness, and extraordinary thermoregulation.
The model features a classic vertical rib knit that slims the figure, a protective high neck with a zip closure embellished with internal details and a logoed puller. Perfect for a casual-chic look as well as for refined leisure time.
 Material: 100% Baby Cashmere (the most precious cashmere in the world, obtained exclusively from the undercoat of Hircus goat kids)
 Colour: Light beige melange / Very light grey (a neutral and sophisticated shade)
 Model: Quarter-Zip / Ribbed half-zip
The sweater has been worn and stored with extreme care. It shows some small and normal signs of wear due to use (such as very light and natural surface pilling in friction areas, typical of pure, non-chemically treated cashmere), but has no holes, obvious stains, or pulled threads. The weave maintains its iconic and soft original softness intact.
Immediate shipping and careful packaging to preserve the yarn. A true investment for the male wardrobe.

Exclusive rigid briefcase (attaché case) from the house of Fendi, Rome. This is an authentic vintage model from the time when Fendi operated under the company name "Fendi SAS" (approx. 1970s/80s). As the model was made before 1980/1990, it does not have a modern alphanumeric serial number, but it is unmistakably identifiable by its distinctive emblem.
Material & Finish:
Exterior: Classic canvas with vertical stripes and logo in medium brown. The vertical "FENDI" lettering creates a discrete graphic pattern.
Frame: The case is fully bordered with sturdy smooth leather. The hand-stitched contrast seams are a testament to the house's high art of saddlery.
Interior: Fully lined with high-quality leather (no fabric lining), which emphasizes the luxurious design of this business model. Interior compartment for documents, pens closable with a press stud.
Hardware & Fittings:
Emblem: Brass emblem inside the case with the engraving "FENDI – ROMA – ITALY.
Fittings: Solid brass hinges and feet.
Closure: Functional combination lock and key.
The condition is very good, with minimal signs of wear, but without stains or tears. The leather is only slightly worn on the handle.

name: Sherpa silk backpack
description:
This Sherpa backpack, often simply called the "Journey to the Land of Stars" backpack, is a collector's limited edition from the early 2000s.

It was created specifically for a Hermès exhibition in Japan titled "Journey to the Land of Stars".

The screen-printed design on the front represents constellations in the shape of an "H" (for Hermès) with French writing ("Voyage Hermès en Terre d'Étoiles") and Japanese annotations (notably エルメス for "Hermès", 星 for "Star", and 地球 for "Earth").

This bag is made of glittery midnight blue satin/textured nylon, which gives it this "starry sky" effect. The interior has a waterproof compartment.

It is a "Sherpa" type backpack with sturdy canvas straps on the back, a main closure by tightening the straps and a flat, rounded bottom that allows it to stand upright.

Despite some light signs of wear and time, it is in excellent overall condition.

name: Garden Party tote
description:
A crisp navy cotton canvas defines this Hermès tote, its body framed by wide
vertical bands in rust—a color combination that subtly references the house’s
equestrian roots. The silhouette is clean and functional, with the only
hardware being a single silver-tone snap button at the open top, its subtle gleam
catching the light where the lines meet. The tote features no overt
branding, eschewing the classic H or Ex Libris logo in favor of a deliberate
minimalism typical of Hermès’ early 2000s canvas accessories, designed for
discreet everyday elegance rather than ostentatious display. The interior is unlined,
showcasing the weight and weave of pure cotton, and the bag’s softly structured
form sits comfortably in the crook of the arm or over the shoulder. Hermès,
founded in Paris in 1837 as a harness workshop, has always prioritized exacting

everyday silhouette that stands in quiet contrast to its more formal leather

construction detail of the line.

corners. The red webbing handles and stripes remain intact and firm, and the
palladium-tone snap closure is fully functional. The interior canvas is

name: Leather handbag
description:
For sale is a superb vintage 1993 Louis Vuitton "Ourval P. Case" hard briefcase in Spruce green Taïga leather. Featuring classic structured lines, a sturdy top handle, and timeless golden hardware.



Condition and Project Details:
I initially purchased this briefcase as a personal restoration project. It is priced accordingly. It would be a really fun project. The exterior of the briefcase is in perfect condition. The interior is sticky.

Exterior: In beautiful vintage condition. The textured Taïga leather has aged gracefully, maintaining its shape exceptionally well with minimal surface wear. The hardware shows a beautiful vintage patina.

Interior: Like many vintage luxury briefcases of this era, the interior pocket linings have suffered from age-related peeling and stickiness. It is still physically functional but feels sticky to the touch.

Restoration Work Completed: I have already removed the lining of the interior pockets to start the restoration process before pausing the project. I removed the pockets with a washcloth and hot water only. You can see this in 2 photos - look at the 2 pockets inside the briefcase. I have not tried anything else on the bag.

Professional Repair Options: I requested a preliminary evaluation directly from Louis Vuitton care services. They provided an official quote of $1,930 US to completely replace all interior linings to bring it back to a like-new boutique condition (a screenshot of this official quote from June 2026 is included in the photos for your reference).

This is an extraordinary opportunity for a leather restoration enthusiast to finish the stripping/lining themselves, or for a collector to send it to the Louis Vuitton Atelier to obtain an impeccable, factory-refurbished heritage piece at a fraction of the modern retail price. You could also use the briefcase without taking these steps. It is still functional.

The original lock is not included but the bag still closes and opens easily.

Please carefully review all photos and contact us with any questions before purchasing.

description:
'Grip Spring' VALEXTRA Wallet

Embodying Valextra's commitment to engineered beauty, the Grip Spring - named after its internal metallic bank-note grip - is a wallet that has held its provenance since it was incepted in 1951. The grip and magnetic snap-shut coin compartment are integral to this iconic design that has become a symbol of quiet luxury. This pocket-sized wallet folds like a fan to fit discreetly in blazer or trouser pockets.

An intuitive wallet crafted from signature Millepunte calf skin.

Its metallic bank-note grip and magnetic snap-shut coin compartment provide room for essentials.

Its fine black Inchiostro - meaning ink in Italian - lines are handpainted by artisans using an ink formula unique to Valextra.

Valextra’s signature black lacquered Costa edges are painted by hand.

Comes boxed with dustbag and has been lightly used (pls see pics)
